facts.fact: The communications minister's office, speaking at an NGF-NDPC workshop, said the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 provides the legal foundation for data governance across all tiers of government and urged states to implement it.

NDPC National Commissioner Olatunji said Nigeria has over 10,000 certified data protection officers and over 27,000 people in its privacy ecosystem, against fewer than 1,000 three years earlier, and held a two-day implementation workshop with the NGF for state governments.
NDPC National Commissioner and CEO Vincent Olatunji addressed the workshop and urged states to adopt policies and frameworks rather than separate state data protection laws.
